panels.title: Overall health
panels.description: Green means the service and all warning signals are clear. Amber means core service remains available but an actionable warning needs review. Red is reserved for core availability faults or dangerous budget use. Missing data is never treated as healthy.

targets.expr: (tubepulse_collector_collection_success * tubepulse_collector_host_collection_success * tubepulse_host_ready * tubepulse_host_authority_current * tubepulse_host_scheduler_active * tubepulse_authority_backend_ready * tubepulse_notifications_barrier_healthy * (tubepulse_host_last_error_present == bool 0) * ((time() - tubepulse_collector_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < bool 960) * (scalar(sum(tubepulse_cloudflare_worker_errors{period="window"})) == bool 0) * (scalar(tubepulse:d1_write_budget_ratio) < bool 0.9) * (scalar(tubepulse:worker_request_budget_ratio) < bool 0.9) * (scalar(max(tubepulse_youtube_quota_used / tubepulse_youtube_quota_limit)) < bool 0.9)) * (1 + (tubepulse_collector_cloudflare_collection_success * tubepulse_subscription_integrity_consistent * (tubepulse_authority_pending_backup_consecutive_samples < bool 2) * (tubepulse_authority_transaction_active_consecutive_samples < bool 2) * (tubepulse_notifications_durable_backlog == bool 0) * (tubepulse_notifications_callback_pending == bool 0) * (tubepulse_notifications_ambiguous_sending == bool 0) * (tubepulse_notifications_retained_failures == bool 0) * (tubepulse_notifications_failed == bool 0) * (tubepulse_youtube_last_error_present == bool 0) * ((time() - tubepulse_collector_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < bool 660) * (scalar(tubepulse:d1_write_budget_ratio) < bool 0.7) * (scalar(tubepulse:d1_read_budget_ratio) < bool 0.7) * (scalar(tubepulse:d1_write_projected_end_of_day / on() tubepulse_guardrail{resource="d1_rows_written_day"}) < bool 0.7) * (scalar(tubepulse:worker_request_budget_ratio) < bool 0.7) * (scalar(max(tubepulse_youtube_quota_used / tubepulse_youtube_quota_limit)) < bool 0.7) * (scalar(sum(tubepulse_cloudflare_worker_requests{period="window",script!="tubepulse-api"}) or vector(0)) == bool 0)))

panels.title: Data freshness
panels.description: Age of the last fully successful aggregate collection. The collector runs every five minutes; amber allows one delayed interval and red indicates multiple missed intervals.

panels.title: Host authority
panels.description: Confirms that the local host is ready, authoritative data is current and the D1 backup backend is ready.

panels.title: Active risks
panels.description: Compact severity for queues, transactions, integrity, API/Worker failures, notification delivery and budget danger. Warning-only conditions are amber; red indicates a core fault. Use Diagnostics for detail.

targets.expr: (tubepulse_collector_collection_success * tubepulse_collector_host_collection_success * tubepulse_host_ready * tubepulse_host_authority_current * tubepulse_host_scheduler_active * tubepulse_authority_backend_ready * tubepulse_notifications_barrier_healthy * (tubepulse_host_last_error_present == bool 0) * ((time() - tubepulse_collector_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < bool 960) * (scalar(sum(tubepulse_cloudflare_worker_errors{period="window"})) == bool 0) * (scalar(tubepulse:d1_write_budget_ratio) < bool 0.9) * (scalar(tubepulse:worker_request_budget_ratio) < bool 0.9) * (scalar(max(tubepulse_youtube_quota_used / tubepulse_youtube_quota_limit)) < bool 0.9)) * (1 + (tubepulse_collector_cloudflare_collection_success * tubepulse_subscription_integrity_consistent * (tubepulse_authority_pending_backup_consecutive_samples < bool 2) * (tubepulse_authority_transaction_active_consecutive_samples < bool 2) * (tubepulse_notifications_durable_backlog == bool 0) * (tubepulse_notifications_callback_pending == bool 0) * (tubepulse_notifications_ambiguous_sending == bool 0) * (tubepulse_notifications_retained_failures == bool 0) * (tubepulse_notifications_failed == bool 0) * (tubepulse_youtube_last_error_present == bool 0) * ((time() - tubepulse_collector_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < bool 660) * (scalar(tubepulse:d1_write_budget_ratio) < bool 0.7) * (scalar(tubepulse:d1_read_budget_ratio) < bool 0.7) * (scalar(tubepulse:d1_write_projected_end_of_day / on() tubepulse_guardrail{resource="d1_rows_written_day"}) < bool 0.7) * (scalar(tubepulse:worker_request_budget_ratio) < bool 0.7) * (scalar(max(tubepulse_youtube_quota_used / tubepulse_youtube_quota_limit)) < bool 0.7) * (scalar(sum(tubepulse_cloudflare_worker_requests{period="window",script!="tubepulse-api"}) or vector(0)) == bool 0)))

panels.title: Active 24h
panels.description: Aggregate installations active during the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Active 7d
panels.description: Aggregate installations active during the last seven days.

panels.title: Push capable
panels.description: Aggregate installations with a current push token.

panels.title: Active channels
panels.description: Unique channels currently active across aggregate subscription state.

panels.title: Max / install
panels.description: Largest aggregate channel count configured by any installation. This is a scale indicator, not a fault threshold.

panels.title: D1 writes today
panels.description: UTC-day rows written as a percentage of the configured daily guardrail. Cloudflare analytics are delayed and approximate.

panels.title: D1 projected EOD
panels.description: Projected UTC end-of-day D1 writes as a percentage of the configured daily guardrail. The projection is stabilized during the first UTC hour.

panels.title: YouTube quota
panels.description: Persisted YouTube Data API quota consumption relative to each configured limit. General and statistics quotas are independent.

panels.title: Notifications
panels.description: Delivery is healthy only when the visibility barrier is healthy and no durable, callback, ambiguous-send, retained-failure or last-cycle failure is pending.

targets.expr: tubepulse_notifications_barrier_healthy * (tubepulse_notifications_durable_backlog == bool 0) * (tubepulse_notifications_callback_pending == bool 0) * (tubepulse_notifications_ambiguous_sending == bool 0) * (tubepulse_notifications_retained_failures == bool 0) * (tubepulse_notifications_failed == bool 0)

panels.title: Worker requests / 5m
panels.description: Aggregate Worker request volume in each finalized five-minute Cloudflare window, providing a directly comparable request-rate trend.

panels.title: D1 rows / window
panels.description: Rows read and written in each delayed, finalized five-minute Cloudflare analytics window.

panels.title: Notification outcomes
panels.description: Aggregate outcomes from recent notification cycles. Failures and durable backlog should remain at zero.

panels.title: Actionable signals
panels.description: Only non-zero signals appear beside the summary. Warning-only counts are amber; core availability or dangerous budget conditions become red. Zero means there is no current queue, transaction, drift, API failure, delivery failure, Worker error or legacy-script traffic.
